title: Seattle, Monday
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
logline: Wood and Chloe on the Greyhound, side by side. The strip says he went. The strip is lying.

panels.composition: The inside of a Greyhound. WOOD and CHLOE side by side, the overcoat and the Discman. The window full of spruce going by.

image.prompt: two young people side by side in Greyhound bus seats, a thin man in an oversized chore coat by the window and a young woman with a Discman on the aisle, spruce blurring past the glass, brush-pen black and white

balloons.text: Someone has to make sure you don't get interesting without supervision.

image.prompt: close-up of a young man in a bus seat, deadpan, spruce in the window

panels.composition: Chloe, one earbud out, handing him the other.

image.prompt: a young woman handing one earbud to the young man beside her on a bus

panels.composition: The bus from outside, small on 101, heading north. Both of them in the window. That's what the strip claims.

image.prompt: a Greyhound bus small on a coastal highway heading north between spruce, two silhouettes visible in one window, black and white, no words
image.notes: This is the delusion. Draw it straight, no wink.
